caption: The drawing depicts a single slipper-like object placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The slipper is rendered in brown, with the front, closed portion appearing structured and leathery. Attached to the back of the slipper is a strap that arches over and appears to be made of a softer, flexible material in a darker brown shade. The inner sole of the slipper, visible from the side, is a dark, nearly black color. The edges and contours are carefully outlined, with shading indicating slight wear and texture on the surfaces. There are no other objects, decorations, or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Stirrup Shoe
